extension_description.message: Stops pages from taking your click to open or redirect somewhere you did not ask for.

app_title.description: Title shown in the container app and the popup.

popup_guard_label.description: Label of the master on/off switch.

popup_guard_on.description: State of the master switch when the guard is running.

popup_guard_off.description: State of the master switch when the guard is paused.

popup_page_heading.description: Heading of the section about the current tab.

popup_page_quiet.message: This page has not reached for another site.
popup_page_quiet.description: Shown when no cross-site destination was recorded.

popup_page_empty.description: Shown when the destination list is empty.

popup_stopped_one.description: How many attempts were blocked on this page, singular.

popup_stopped_other.description: How many attempts were blocked on this page, plural.

popup_seen_one.description: How many cross-site attempts were recorded, singular.

popup_seen_other.description: How many cross-site attempts were recorded, plural.

popup_tries_one.description: How many times one destination came up, singular.

popup_tries_other.description: How many times one destination came up, plural.

popup_recipe_heading.description: Heading for a per-site fix that was applied.

state_blocked.description: A destination that is being stopped.

state_allowed.description: A destination that is being let through.

scope_here.description: The rule was set for the current site only.

scope_everywhere.description: The rule was set for every site.

scope_default.description: No rule was set, so the default applies.

action_allow_here.description: Let this destination through on the current site.

action_allow_everywhere.description: Let this destination through on every site.

action_block_here.description: Stop this destination on the current site.

action_block_everywhere.description: Stop this destination on every site.

popup_policy_heading.description: Label above the default policy choice.

policy_block.description: Default policy: stop unknown cross-site destinations.

policy_allow.description: Default policy: let unknown cross-site destinations through.

popup_bridge_warning.message: This page blocks extension scripts. Only part of the guard is running.
popup_bridge_warning.description: Shown when the page CSP stopped the page-world script.

kind_click_catcher.description: A transparent form or link laid over the page.

kind_overlay.description: A see-through element covering the page.

kind_synthetic_click.description: A click the page dispatched itself.

kind_form_submit.description: A form submitted to a new tab.

kind_href_swap.description: An anchor rewritten between press and release.

kind_back_hijack.description: A navigation right after the back gesture.

popup_rules_link.description: Opens the list of every rule the user has set.

popup_page_link.description: Goes back from the rules list to the current page.

rules_everywhere_heading.description: Heading for rules that apply on every site.

rules_by_site_heading.description: Heading for rules that apply to a single site.

rules_empty.description: Shown when a rules list has no entries.

action_clear.description: Remove a rule so the default applies.

setting_banner.description: Toggle for the note drawn in the page when something is stopped.

action_report.description: Opens a prefilled issue about a site the guard missed.
